metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and mods by Marc Mayol: Meter for Claude Code, your plan usage (5h, 7d and an estimated month) at the bottom right; Context Bar, the context window filling up towards auto-compact; Agent Names, subagents named "Project: task"; Creality Print, slice and run Creality printers from Claude Code; Humanizar, clean and score Spanish text so it doesn't read like AI; verify-seo-for-agents, check whether a website is ready for AI agents; Omoikane, long-term memory with automatic recall.

plugins.name: meter-for-claude-code
plugins.description: Plan usage at the bottom right of the prompt: 5-hour session, weekly window and an estimated month (M), calibrated from your own transcripts.

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: The session's context window as a bar in the footer, with a mark where auto-compact kicks in: green, amber as it nears the compact, red right before it.

plugins.name: agent-names
plugins.description: Subagents named "Project: task", so with several sessions open you can tell which one each agent belongs to. Refuses any other name.

plugins.name: creality-print
plugins.description: Slice with Creality Print, check gcode, handle colours and the CFS, and run Creality OS printers (K2, K1…). Unofficial.

plugins.name: humanizar
plugins.description: Clean and score Spanish text (0-100) so it doesn't read like AI: invisible characters, Unicode bold, filler, "it's not X, it's Y", em dashes, hashtag walls. Local heuristics, no API. Also an MCP server for 14 other agents.

plugins.name: verify-seo-for-agents
plugins.description: Check whether a website is ready for AI agents, and fix what fails: 23 checks, a level from 0 to 5 and a guide for each failure. Runs on your machine and can scan localhost. Installs its own binary on first use.

plugins.name: omoikane
plugins.description: Long-term memory for Claude Code: what it learns in one session comes back in the next. Local SQLite, duplicate detection, and automatic recall of the memories that matter for each prompt. Installs its own omoi binary on first use.
